requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health and hold a valid foreign passport under the Nationality Law of the PRC.
Be at least 18 years old and, in principle, under age 25.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants born abroad to one or two Chinese-citizen parents settled abroad
requirements.ruleText: Meet Ministry of Education Notice JWH [2020] No. 12 and the published nationality-review conditions.
Hold at least a high-school degree and have good academic records.
HSK 5 score 180 or above, or an accepted equivalent; prior Chinese-medium education may qualify for the published exemption.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants to the exact programs bound to this template
requirements.ruleText: Submit a CSCA report using SCU's published category-and-language matrix: liberal arts Chinese—Chinese Language and Mathematics; liberal arts English—Mathematics; science/engineering Chinese—Chinese Language, Mathematics and Physics; science/engineering English—Mathematics and Physics; medical Chinese—Chinese Language, Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry; medical English—Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.

references.locator: Application Documents item 11 and CSCA category matrix

requirements.ruleText: Submit the online application from January 1 through May 30, 2026.
Apply through the SCU Overseas Students Office online system within the published application period; sponsor-funded routes must also follow the sponsor system stated by the official guide.
Submit the passport first page, valid for at least six months from application; applicants living in mainland China also submit the valid visa or residence permit.
Submit the high-school graduation certificate or a school-sealed pre-graduation certificate stating the expected graduation date.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants living in China or with prior study in China
requirements.ruleText: Submit the previous Chinese school's document describing the applicant's performance at school.
Submit school-sealed high-school academic transcripts.
Submit a Chinese or English personal statement covering self-introduction, reasons for applying, understanding of the major and study plan; English-taught applicants must write it in English.
HSK 5 score 180 or above, or an accepted equivalent; prior Chinese-medium education may qualify for the published exemption.

references.locator: Application Documents item 6 and Eligibility item 4

requirements.ruleText: Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form with results no more than six months old at application.

Submit funding-source or guardian financial-guarantee evidence, such as a family bank deposit certificate and parent/guardian income certificate; SCU recommends at least USD 5,000. Full-scholarship applicants are exempt.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate issued by the local public-security authority no more than six months before application.
Optionally submit award certificates or other supporting documents.
Upload authentic electronic records; documents in other languages require official Chinese or English translations. SCU does not process incomplete applications and may request additional records.

Use the official annual category schedule for this route: Official category schedule: CNY 17,500-45,000/year; the exact amount depends on humanities/economics/management, science/engineering, medicine, stomatology, clinical medicine, arts/sports or archaeology classification. SCU publishes category bands rather than a row-level amount, so the applicable category must be confirmed without inferring a price.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health, hold a valid foreign passport, and be age 18-40.
Hold a bachelor's degree.

Humanities routes: HSK 5 score 180 or above; science, engineering, medicine and agriculture routes: HSK 4 score 180 or above; accepted equivalents and the published prior Chinese-medium education exemption may apply.
Submit the online application from November 1, 2025 through May 30, 2026.
Apply through the SCU Overseas Students Office online system; sponsor-funded routes must also follow the sponsor system stated by the official guide.
Submit the passport first page, valid for at least six months from application; applicants living in mainland China also submit the valid visa or residence permit.
Submit the bachelor's graduation/degree certificate or university-sealed pre-graduation certificate stating the expected graduation date.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants living in China or with prior study in China
requirements.ruleText: Submit the previous Chinese school's document describing the applicant's performance at school.
Submit university-sealed undergraduate academic transcripts.

Submit two recommendation letters from professors, associate professors or equivalent experts in the intended major, including handwritten signature, title, affiliation, phone number and email address.
Submit a Chinese or English study and research plan covering self-introduction, reasons for applying, understanding of the major and study plan; English-taught applicants must write it in English.
Optionally submit contents and abstracts of academic papers.

Humanities routes: HSK 5 score 180 or above; science, engineering, medicine and agriculture routes: HSK 4 score 180 or above; accepted equivalents and the published prior Chinese-medium education exemption may apply.

references.locator: Application Documents item 8 and Eligibility item 3

requirements.ruleText: Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form with results no more than six months old at application.

Submit funding-source or guardian financial-guarantee evidence, such as a family bank deposit certificate and parent/guardian income certificate; SCU recommends at least USD 5,000. Full-scholarship applicants are exempt.
Submit a certificate of employment when applicable.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate issued by the local public-security authority no more than six months before application.
Optionally submit award certificates or other supporting documents.
Upload authentic electronic records; documents in other languages require official Chinese or English translations. SCU does not process incomplete applications and may request additional records.

Use the official annual category schedule for this route: Official category schedule: CNY 22,000-50,000/year; the exact amount depends on discipline, including separate MBA and MEM rates.
